prompt:
The table below shows the average number of hours per day that three age groups in one country spent on six activities in 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Average hours per day spent on six activities by age group, 2022
visual.alt: A table showing the average number of hours per day three age groups spent on six activities; each column adds up to 24 hours.

key_points: Sleep and personal care is the longest activity in all three groups (8.8-9.5 hours) and the row with the smallest difference between groups
Paid work or study peaks in the 30-49 age group (7.5 hours) and falls to about half that among the over-50s (3.6 hours) — the largest difference between groups
Housework and caring for others rises steadily with age (1.8 → 3.4 → 3.9 hours)
Total leisure time is highest among the over-50s (3.0 + 3.2 = 6.2 hours) and lowest in the 30-49 group (2.8 hours)
Screen-based leisure is highest in the 18-29 group (3.4 hours); non-screen leisure is highest among the over-50s (3.2 hours)
Travel is the shortest activity in every group (0.9-1.5 hours); each column adds up to 24 hours
common_mistakes: Reading through all eighteen cells one by one instead of highlighting the inverse relationship between work and leisure
Comparing only rows and not making comparisons between age groups
Confusing hours with percentages ('30% of their day')
Inventing reasons ('older people are retired, so…') — the table gives no such information
